text: I need a straight answer please, no waffle. My daughter is 3. About forty minutes ago she had a fit. Her whole body went stiff, then her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled back. It lasted maybe a minute, maybe a bit more, I wasn't timing it properly. It's never happened before, not once. Her temperature afterwards was 37.8°C. Since then she keeps covering her eyes with her hands and turning her face into the pillow. She told me the light hurts, so I've switched the big light off and she's only OK with the hall light on through the door. Her dad is getting the car keys now. Do we go straight to A&E or call an ambulance? Tell me which.
